/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	Grid.Rows = Page.Rows
	Grid_Empowerer.GridInternalName = Grid.InternalName
	DDO_GridColumnsSelector.GridInternalName = Grid.InternalName
	If &HTTPRequest.Method = HttpMethod.Get
		Do 'LoadSavedFilters'
	EndIf
	ddo_AGExport.TitleControlIdToReplace = BtnAGExport.InternalName
	&AGExportData = new()
	
	&TempBoolean = SecGAMIsAuthByFunctionalityKey.Udp(!'productoterminado_Insert')
	If (&TempBoolean)
		&AGExportDataItem = new()
		&AGExportDataItem.Title = ''
		&AGExportDataItem.Icon = ActionAdd.Link()
		&AGExportDataItem.Link = DB.ProductoTerminado.Link(TrnMode.Insert, nullvalue(ProductoTerminadoId))
		&AGExportDataItem.IsDivider = False
		&AGExportData.Add(&AGExportDataItem)
	Endif
	
	&AGExportDataItem = new()
	&AGExportDataItem.Title = ''
	&AGExportDataItem.Icon = ActionExport.Link()
	&AGExportDataItem.EventKey = !'Export'
	&AGExportDataItem.IsDivider = False
	&AGExportData.Add(&AGExportDataItem)
	
	&AGExportDataItem = new()
	&AGExportDataItem.Title = ''
	&AGExportDataItem.Icon = ActionExportReport.Link()
	&AGExportDataItem.EventKey = !'ExportReport'
	&AGExportDataItem.IsDivider = False
	&AGExportData.Add(&AGExportDataItem)
	
	&GAMSession = GAMSession.Get(&GAMErrors)
	DDO_Grid.GridInternalName = Grid.InternalName
	DDO_Grid.GAMOAuthToken = &GAMSession.Token
	Form.Caption = ' Producto Terminado'
	Do 'PrepareTransaction'
	Do 'LoadGridState'
	If &OrderedBy < 1
		&OrderedBy = 1
		Do 'SetDDOSortedStatus'
	EndIf
	&DDO_TitleSettingsIcons = GetWWPTitleSettingsIcons()
	DDO_GridColumnsSelector.TitleControlIdToReplace = BtnEditColumns.InternalName
	GridPaginationBar.RowsPerPageSelectedValue = Grid.Rows
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	LoadWWPContext.Call(&WWPContext)
	Do 'CheckSecurityForActions'
	Do Case
		Case &ManageFiltersExecutionStep = 1
			&ManageFiltersExecutionStep = 2
		Case &ManageFiltersExecutionStep = 2
			&ManageFiltersExecutionStep = 0
			Do 'LoadSavedFilters'
	EndCase
	Do 'SaveGridState'
	
	If &Session.Get(!'Produccion.listarProductoTerminadoColumnsSelector') <> ''
		&ColumnsSelectorXML = &Session.Get(!'Produccion.listarProductoTerminadoColumnsSelector')
		&ColumnsSelector.FromXml(&ColumnsSelectorXML)
	Else
		Do 'InitializeColumnsSelector'
	EndIf
	ProductoTerminadoPalets.Visible = &ColumnsSelector.Columns.Item(1).IsVisible
	ProductoTerminadoCarreteMillar.Visible = &ColumnsSelector.Columns.Item(2).IsVisible
	ProductoTerminadoPaletMillar.Visible = &ColumnsSelector.Columns.Item(3).IsVisible
	ProductoTerminadoPeso.Visible = &ColumnsSelector.Columns.Item(4).IsVisible
	ProductoTerminadoPesoCarrete.Visible = &ColumnsSelector.Columns.Item(5).IsVisible
	ProductoTerminadoPesoPalet.Visible = &ColumnsSelector.Columns.Item(6).IsVisible
	ProductoTerminadoConEtiqueta.Visible = &ColumnsSelector.Columns.Item(7).IsVisible
	ProductoTerminadoEtiquetable.Visible = &ColumnsSelector.Columns.Item(8).IsVisible
	TerminadoProductoNombre.Visible = &ColumnsSelector.Columns.Item(9).IsVisible
	ProductoTerminadoCodigoSAP.Visible = &ColumnsSelector.Columns.Item(10).IsVisible
	ProductoTerminadoMRD.Visible = &ColumnsSelector.Columns.Item(11).IsVisible
	TerminadoProductoActivo.Visible = &ColumnsSelector.Columns.Item(12).IsVisible
	&GridCurrentPage = Grid.CurrentPage
	&GridPageCount = Grid.PageCount
	&GridAppliedFilters = WWP_GetAppliedFiltersDescription(&Pgmname)
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	Do Case
		Case GridPaginationBar.SelectedPage = !'Previous'
			Grid.PreviousPage()
		Case GridPaginationBar.SelectedPage = !'Next'
			Grid.NextPage()
		Otherwise
			&PageToGo.FromString(GridPaginationBar.SelectedPage)
			Grid.GotoPage(&PageToGo)
	EndCase
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	Do Case
		Case DDO_Grid.ActiveEventKey = !'<#OrderASC#>' OR DDO_Grid.ActiveEventKey = !'<#OrderDSC#>'
			&OrderedBy.FromString(DDO_Grid.SelectedValue_get)
			&OrderedDsc = iif(DDO_Grid.ActiveEventKey = !'<#OrderDSC#>', true, false)
			Do 'SetDDOSortedStatus'
			Grid.FirstPage()
		Case DDO_Grid.ActiveEventKey = !'<#Filter#>'
			Do Case
				Case DDO_Grid.SelectedColumn = !'ProductoTerminadoPalets'
					&TFProductoTerminadoPalets.FromString(DDO_Grid.FilteredText_get)
					&TFProductoTerminadoPalets_To.FromString(DDO_Grid.FilteredTextTo_get)
				Case DDO_Grid.SelectedColumn = !'ProductoTerminadoCarreteMillar'
					&TFProductoTerminadoCarreteMillar.FromString(DDO_Grid.FilteredText_get)
					&TFProductoTerminadoCarreteMillar_To.FromString(DDO_Grid.FilteredTextTo_get)
				Case DDO_Grid.SelectedColumn = !'ProductoTerminadoPaletMillar'
					&TFProductoTerminadoPaletMillar.FromString(DDO_Grid.FilteredText_get)
					&TFProductoTerminadoPaletMillar_To.FromString(DDO_Grid.FilteredTextTo_get)
				Case DDO_Grid.SelectedColumn = !'ProductoTerminadoPeso'
					&TFProductoTerminadoPeso.FromString(DDO_Grid.FilteredText_get)
					&TFProductoTerminadoPeso_To.FromString(DDO_Grid.FilteredTextTo_get)
				Case DDO_Grid.SelectedColumn = !'ProductoTerminadoPesoCarrete'
					&TFProductoTerminadoPesoCarrete.FromString(DDO_Grid.FilteredText_get)
					&TFProductoTerminadoPesoCarrete_To.FromString(DDO_Grid.FilteredTextTo_get)
				Case DDO_Grid.SelectedColumn = !'ProductoTerminadoPesoPalet'
					&TFProductoTerminadoPesoPalet.FromString(DDO_Grid.FilteredText_get)
					&TFProductoTerminadoPesoPalet_To.FromString(DDO_Grid.FilteredTextTo_get)
				Case DDO_Grid.SelectedColumn = !'ProductoTerminadoConEtiqueta'
					&TFProductoTerminadoConEtiqueta_Sel.FromString(DDO_Grid.SelectedValue_get)
				Case DDO_Grid.SelectedColumn = !'ProductoTerminadoEtiquetable'
					&TFProductoTerminadoEtiquetable_Sel.FromString(DDO_Grid.SelectedValue_get)
				Case DDO_Grid.SelectedColumn = !'TerminadoProductoNombre'
					&TFTerminadoProductoNombre = DDO_Grid.FilteredText_get
					&TFTerminadoProductoNombre_Sel = DDO_Grid.SelectedValue_get
				Case DDO_Grid.SelectedColumn = !'ProductoTerminadoCodigoSAP'
					&TFProductoTerminadoCodigoSAP = DDO_Grid.FilteredText_get
					&TFProductoTerminadoCodigoSAP_Sel = DDO_Grid.SelectedValue_get
				Case DDO_Grid.SelectedColumn = !'ProductoTerminadoMRD'
					&TFProductoTerminadoMRD.FromString(DDO_Grid.FilteredText_get)
					&TFProductoTerminadoMRD_To.FromString(DDO_Grid.FilteredTextTo_get)
				Case DDO_Grid.SelectedColumn = !'TerminadoProductoActivo'
					&TFTerminadoProductoActivo_Sel.FromString(DDO_Grid.SelectedValue_get)
			EndCase
			Grid.FirstPage()
	EndCase
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	&Display = "GXM_display"
	If (&IsAuthorized_Display)
		&Display.Link = gestionarProductoTerminado.Link(TrnMode.Display, ProductoTerminadoId)
	Endif
	&Update = "GXM_update"
	If (&IsAuthorized_Update)
		&Update.Link = DB.ProductoTerminado.Link(TrnMode.Update, ProductoTerminadoId)
	Endif
	&Delete = "GX_BtnDelete"
	If (&IsAuthorized_Delete)
		&Delete.Link = DB.ProductoTerminado.Link(TrnMode.Delete, ProductoTerminadoId)
	Endif
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	Do Case
		Case ddo_ManageFilters.ActiveEventKey = !'<#Clean#>'
			Do 'CleanFilters'
			Grid.FirstPage()
			Refresh
		Case ddo_ManageFilters.ActiveEventKey = !'<#Save#>'
			Do 'SaveGridState'
			SaveFilterAs.Popup(!'Produccion.listarProductoTerminadoFilters', &PgmName + !"GridState")
			&ManageFiltersExecutionStep = 2
			Refresh
		Case ddo_ManageFilters.ActiveEventKey = !'<#Manage#>'
			ManageFilters.Popup(!'Produccion.listarProductoTerminadoFilters')
			&ManageFiltersExecutionStep = 2
			Refresh
		Otherwise
			&ManageFiltersXml = GetFilterByName(!'Produccion.listarProductoTerminadoFilters', ddo_ManageFilters.ActiveEventKey)
			If &ManageFiltersXml.IsEmpty()
				msg('WWP_FilterNotExist')
			Else
				Do 'CleanFilters'
				SaveGridState.Call(&PgmName + !"GridState",  &ManageFiltersXml)
				&GridState.FromXml(&ManageFiltersXml)
				&OrderedBy = &GridState.OrderedBy
				&OrderedDsc = &GridState.OrderedDsc
				Do 'SetDDOSortedStatus' 
				Do 'LoadRegFiltersState'
				Grid.FirstPage()
				Refresh
			EndIf
	EndCase
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	Do Case
		Case ddo_AGExport.ActiveEventKey = !'Export'
			Do 'DoExport'
		Case ddo_AGExport.ActiveEventKey = !'ExportReport'
			Do 'DoExportReport'
	EndCase
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */
